album.title: Select Album
album.description: Select an existing album or create a new one. Found {num_albums} app-created albums.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Album
reconfigure.description: Select a different album for this frame. Found {num_albums} albums.

error.no_album_selected: Please select or create an album

auth_failed.title: Authentication failed
auth_failed.description: Authentication with Google Photos has failed for entry {entry_id}. Please re-authenticate the integration.

album_not_found.title: Album not found
album_not_found.description: The configured album '{album_name}' could not be found. Please reconfigure the integration to select a different album.

sync_now.name: Sync Now
sync_now.description: Trigger immediate sync of Google Photos album

get_current_photo.name: Get Current Photo
get_current_photo.description: Get the currently displayed photo without advancing

entry_id.name: Entry ID
entry_id.description: Optional config entry ID (uses first available if not specified)

get_photos.name: Get Photos
get_photos.description: Get a list of all available photos in the album

entry_id.name: Entry ID
entry_id.description: Optional config entry ID (uses first available if not specified)

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of photos to return (1-500, default 100)

offset.name: Offset
offset.description: Number of photos to skip from the beginning (default 0)

next_photo.name: Next Photo
next_photo.description: Go to the next photo and return its info. Respects shuffle mode.

entry_id.name: Entry ID
entry_id.description: Optional config entry ID (uses first available if not specified)

previous_photo.name: Previous Photo
previous_photo.description: Go to the previous photo and return its info. Respects shuffle mode.

entry_id.name: Entry ID
entry_id.description: Optional config entry ID (uses first available if not specified)

set_photo.name: Set Photo
set_photo.description: Jump to a specific photo by index or ID

photo_index.name: Photo Index
photo_index.description: Zero-based index of the photo to display

photo_id.name: Photo ID
photo_id.description: ID of the photo to display (use either index or ID, not both)

clear_cache.name: Clear Cache
clear_cache.description: Clear cached photos and processed images from disk

entry_id.name: Entry ID
entry_id.description: Optional config entry ID (clears all if not specified)
